title: Glowing helicopter
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="42" ry="36" fill="#1a3a2a" opacity="0.6"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="32" ry="26" fill="#2a5a3a" opacity="0.4"/>

  <!-- Main rotor blade -->
  <rect x="8" y="22" width="84" height="4" rx="2" fill="#66ffcc"/>
  <rect x="8" y="22" width="84" height="2" rx="1" fill="#aaffee"/>

  <!-- Rotor mast -->
  <rect x="47" y="26" width="6" height="8" fill="#55ddaa"/>
  <rect x="48" y="26" width="2" height="8" fill="#88ffcc"/>

  <!-- Tail boom -->
  <polygon points="62,52 92,42 92,48 62,58" fill="#44cc88"/>
  <polygon points="62,52 92,42 92,44 62,54" fill="#66eeaa"/>

  <!-- Tail rotor -->
  <circle cx="92" cy="45" r="7" fill="#33bb77" opacity="0.8"/>
  <rect x="89" y="36" width="4" height="18" rx="2" fill="#66ffcc"/>
  <rect x="84" y="43" width="16" height="4" rx="2" fill="#66ffcc"/>

  <!-- Tail fin -->
  <polygon points="86,42 92,36 94,44 88,48" fill="#55dd99"/>
  <polygon points="86,42 92,36 93,38 87,44" fill="#88ffbb"/>

  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="55" rx="22" ry="16" fill="#44bb77"/>
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="53" rx="20" ry="13" fill="#55dd99"/>
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="52" rx="14" ry="9" fill="#66ffbb"/>

  <!-- Cockpit window -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="52" rx="10" ry="9" fill="#99ffee"/>
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="50" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#ccffee" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- Skids -->
  <rect x="28" y="70" width="4" height="6" rx="1" fill="#33aa66"/>
  <rect x="62" y="70" width="4" height="6" rx="1" fill="#33aa66"/>
  <rect x="24" y="76" width="50" height="4" rx="2" fill="#44cc88"/>
  <rect x="24" y="76" width="50" height="2" rx="1" fill="#66eeaa"/>

  <!-- Landing gear struts -->
  <line x1="32" y1="66" x2="30" y2="72" stroke="#55dd99" stroke-width="3"/>
  <line x1="62" y1="66" x2="64" y2="72" stroke="#55dd99" stroke-width="3"/>
</svg>
